이곳의 모든 강의는 <b class=\"text-neutral-900\": Every lecture here is free. No ads, no sponsors, no fees. Someone who closed the Bible after being hurt by a church. Someone who trembled alone, afraid of the end times. Perhaps it was in the very place where you have stood that one minister first passed through the wilderness and met the risen Lord. And for those walking the same road, he began this ministry.
“이 강의가 제 신앙을 다시 살렸습니다.” — 매일 도착하는 이 고백들은: “These lectures brought my faith back to life.” Words like these arrive every day, and they are proof that we are never alone. Even today, one man studies the Scriptures until dawn, adds subtitles, and writes notes. And beside him, one by one, gather those who thirst for the same truth.
